title: Orbit and Vector
author: Quentin Eriksen
blurb: Lena Dunmore, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. But when gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
